specs.Features: Polyaxial Head , Fixed Head , Favored Angle Head , Self Tapping , Extended Reduction Head Tabs

description: The Xia 3 is a pedicle screw system for use in the thoracolumbar spine and intended to treat degenerative, trauma, deformity and adult idiopathic scoliosis (AIS). It is centered around the Xia 3 screw which can accommodate 5.5 and 6.0mm rods. The self tapping screw has a polyaxial head with 50 degrees of conical angulation.
features: Full set of hook options, rod connectors, side connectors, etc
Uniplanar screw: good for one plane angulation for deformity correction. Also available with reduction thread
Polyaxial screw - standard corticocancellous screw 50 degrees conical angulation.
Biased angle: available in medial and cranial-caudal angle
Closed head polyaxial - good for sacro-iliac fusion
